title: AUTH BYPASS: pre-dispatch match processes data commands without auth check
description: In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop, the pre-dispatch match processes Article/Head/Body/Stat/Group/Over/Hdr/Search/Xcid/Xverify/Xget/List(Active)/StartTls/AuthinfoPass/AuthinfoSaslOauthbearer before dispatch() is called. None of these arms check ctx.state == SessionState::Authenticating. When auth.required=true a client in Authenticating state can issue GROUP, ARTICLE, OVER, SEARCH, etc. and receive real data, bypassing the auth gate enforced only inside dispatch(). Trigger: connect with auth.required=true; send GROUP comp.lang.rust before AUTHINFO. Expected: 480. Actual: 211 group selected response.
